subset_8500.missing_input: a file with the 8,500 question ids the frontier tier was evaluated on (json / jsonl / csv with a question_id column) — pass it with --manifest
subset_8500.ready: the whole subset pipeline is implemented: with --manifest it re-runs baselines on the subset, joins per model, reports coverage and missing rows, and emits the subset tables and CIs

frontier_comparison.reason: the frontier tier's own results are not on disk either, so the 16-model combined table and the '16 of 16 below baseline' check cannot be reproduced or verified locally
frontier_comparison.missing_input: frontier per-cell correct counts and baselines (or their stored responses) for the same manifest rows

definitions.raw_exact: the published comparison function with the numeric tolerance set to zero (normalisation, whole-word text matching, multi-part all-parts and structured ground truth parsing unchanged)
definitions.raw_published: the frozen-rule accuracy already published on the site (1% / 0.05 tolerance)
definitions.baseline: max over distinct stored ground-truth values of (count == v) / n, per (domain, level), computed from the model's own evaluated response set
definitions.adjusted: (accuracy - baseline) / (1 - baseline); baseline == 1.0 is excluded from all aggregates
definitions.macro: unweighted mean of per-cell adjusted scores over non-constant cells
definitions.pooled: sum(correct) and sum(baseline*n) over non-constant cells, transformed once
definitions.bootstrap: image-level resampling, 10000 resamples, one shared draw per replicate across levels and models, baselines held fixed
